name: MonliPay
tagline: Send tokens with a link. Choose a payment, private payment, or a group giveaway.
problem: Sending crypto usually starts with exchanging wallet addresses. Group distributions add repeated transfers, recipient lists, and manual tracking.
solution: MonliPay turns a funded token transfer into a link you can share in an existing chat. Standard Payment Links send one amount to one recipient. Lucky Links split a pool into random shares for open giveaways or selected wallets, using Pyth Entropy. Private Payment adds an optional AnomaPay transfer on Monad mainnet. A wallet-scoped address book avoids re-entering recipients. Passkeys open browser-encrypted saved links without a manual recovery-file setup. Each mode explains its fees, recovery behavior and privacy limits before use.
existing_baseline: Commit 5544bf7: LinkVault payment links, bridge integration, Ponder indexer, and existing wallet support predate this Metropolis work. MonliPay is an extension of an existing project.
metropolis_work: LuckyVault with ERC-20/native pools, wallet eligibility, Pyth Entropy draws, withdrawal, expiry and refund logic.
Private wallet-authenticated contacts persisted on the backend.
Consistent payment-first design with Lucky Link as an optional mode.
Mainnet and testnet deployment with exact-match Sourcify verification for LuckyVault.
Unified My Links, explicit refunds, ERC-20 approval and accurate six-decimal token displays.
Real testnet product demo and public video player.
Passkey access to browser-encrypted Payment Links, legacy-key migration, wallet-scoped persistence, idle locking and an encrypted retry queue.

AnomaPay Private Payment create, claim and reclaim flows, lazy-loaded SDK/WASM, verified onchain resources, exact Permit2 binding, fee review, encrypted private account and operation records, and interruption recovery without automatic duplicate submission.
Unified Payment, Private and Lucky history filters; explicit privacy page; 104-second video combining real testnet transactions with a labelled privacy interface walkthrough.
Responsive landing motion: envelope/token arrival, layered scroll parallax, mouse perspective, reduced-motion and static-render fallbacks, with no added animation dependency.
Original MonliPay M mark, refreshed app icons and demo poster; private passkey panel spacing and concise interface copy.

Open Lucky giveaways with first-come wallet slots, explicit selected-wallet mode, shared searchable token picker with logos/contract addresses/imports, and backward-compatible V1/V2 claim links and history.
validation: Real native Lucky Link testnet creation, Pyth callback, withdrawal and expiry refund; 122 existing contract tests passed during this build window.
Real six-decimal DEMOUSD Payment Link approval, funding and claim; the demo token has no monetary value.

Authorized 1 MON mainnet private pilot: wrapped MON, deposited WMON, sent 0.5 WMON to a separate bearer account, claimed, recovered the sender remainder and unwrapped. Protocol fees: 0.230736921281629696 WMON. Wallet gas: 0.037193076 MON. Remaining private resources and Permit2 allowance: zero.

Native Chromium WebAuthn PRF setup and reload/unlock; encrypted storage acknowledgement, wrong-wallet rejection, uncertain wallet result recovery and no automatic resubmission. These are virtual authenticator checks, not physical-device or cross-device certification.

779 web tests across 55 files and 20 Anoma integration tests pass; Next.js 16.4.0 production build and scoped lint pass. Impeccable reviewed 17 desktop/mobile captures; the failed-state wording correction was scored resolved.

Live passkey enrollment, encrypted account creation, refresh/unlock, wrong-wallet401, unfunded claim discovery and 104-second video passed. Both containers were replaced again; ciphertext and all existing encrypted records were preserved.

Landing motion deployed on both networks; live pointer and scroll parallax, reduced motion, Create navigation and private-payment gates checked. Existing encrypted records remained unchanged during replacement.

Brand and copy refinement: 75 existing component tests and both production builds passed. Private panel measured 28px desktop / 20px mobile; production TS/TSX text scan found no em dashes. Existing lint findings in Bridge, LinkCard and ShareLink matched the prior commit. Impeccable reviewed seven captures and returned ship. Both deployments passed live browser checks; encrypted records were preserved and the source download hash matched. Details are recorded in brand-release.json.

V2 LuckyVault exact-match verified on mainnet/testnet. Open giveaway funded on testnet with real Pyth callback, withdrawal and expiry refund; duplicate claims and withdrawals rejected. Contract suite and web tests passed; deployment receipt in open-lucky-release.json.
limits: Standard Payment and Lucky Link claims require network gas; Lucky draws also require a variable MON oracle fee. Public gas sponsorship is disabled.
Private claims deduct a protocol fee from the link balance. The receiving wallet does not need MON for that relayed withdrawal. MON funding wraps to WMON and the recipient receives WMON.

Private Payment is beta and mainnet-only. Transfers inside AnomaPay are shielded from public chain observers; deposits, withdrawals and correlation remain visible risks. Proving operators receive plaintext witness data. This is not complete anonymity.
Private links have no expiry or automatic refund. The sender or any other holder can reclaim an unspent link; the first successful spend wins.
Only WMON has funded private end-to-end validation. Mainnet stablecoin transfers were not exercised.

Wallet eligibility is not proof of one human per wallet. Passkey PRF support depends on the browser and provider, and lost passkeys cannot be reset. No independent security audit or enterprise certification is claimed.
The 80-second transaction demo uses Monad testnet and an automated dedicated wallet; the added 24-second privacy interface walkthrough is explicitly separate from the real funded mainnet pilot.
submission_status: App and submission package ready. Mainnet/testnet deployment, encrypted history persistence and public source download verified. Portal submission has not been sent. GitHub branch publication awaits repository write access; use the published source ZIP.
judge_quickstart: Open https://testnet.monlipay.xyz/create with a Monad testnet wallet for standard MON payment or Lucky Link testing. A sender and receiver need faucet MON; choose Anyone for a public giveaway or Selected wallets to restrict eligibility.
Open https://monlipay.xyz/my-links, verify your wallet and use a PRF-compatible passkey to open encrypted links. Contacts use the wallet signature session.

Explore https://monlipay.xyz/create/private on mainnet. Connect a wallet and set up a passkey before funding. Review fees and privacy limits. No mainnet spend is necessary to review the already-published pilot receipts.

Download the source archive at https://monlipay.xyz/submission/monlipay-metropolis-source-open-20261013.zip. It includes the build-window delta, contract source, tests, pinned integration, setup instructions, and public transaction receipts.
